title: ox-30_ox-33_ox-34 Oxynext Poultry Liquid Supplement for Birds, 1 Litre, Easy-to-Mix Liquid Formula for Poultry Farming, Suitable for Broilers and Layers
description: Oxynext Poultry Care Combo Pack brings together carefully selected poultry care products in one convenient package to support routine flock management. Designed for poultry farmers, commercial farms, hatcheries, and backyard poultry keepers, these combo packs help simplify inventory management by combining complementary Oxynext products into a single purchase. Each product is manufactured under quality-controlled processes and packed securely to maintain product integrity during storage and transportation. The products included in the combo should be used individually according to the directions provided on their respective labels. Suitable for broilers, layers, growers, and other poultry birds as part of regular poultry management practices, this value pack offers convenience, trusted Oxynext quality, and an economical solution for stocking essential poultry care products. Always read and follow the instructions on each product before use and store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and out of reach of children.
